The Kerala State Lottery Department is set to announce the Samrudhi SM-47 lottery results on Sunday, March 22. Participants have the opportunity to win major cash rewards, including a first prize of Rs 1 crore, a second prize of Rs 25 lakh, and a third prize of Rs 5 lakh.
